summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The WisdomTree International High Dividend Fund (DTH) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high dividend yield equity. The fund tracks a dividend-weighted index of developed-market stocks, excluding the US and Canada, ranked in the top 30% by dividend yield of the WisdomTree DEFA Index. DTH was launched on Jun 16, 2006 and is issued by WisdomTree.

holdings.infoBox: DTH is an equity ETF with a total of 574 individual holdings. The top holdings are HSBC Holdings stock at 3.18%, Shell at 2.45%, Intesa Sanpaolo at 2.36%, Nestlé at 2.11%, and Equinor ASA at 1.92%.
